A '''dam''' was built on the planet [[Yalara]] and was still standing by [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]]. It possessed a tower where a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] sat upon. Part of the [[Dam/Legends|dam]]'s tower was demolished after [[Jaden Korr]]'s [[mission to Yalara]], in which he destroyed the device with an explosion.<ref name="JKJA" />
